votes.motion: Approve the minutes from the work session of May 23, 2023 and the formal meeting minutes for April 18, 2023 and May 23, 2023.
votes.description: Approval of prior meeting minutes from the May 23, 2023 work session and the April 18, 2023 and May 23, 2023 formal meetings.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and approve Ordinance 45 of 2023 Historic Carriage House Text Amendment, amending Section 21A.34.020 of the Zoning Ordinance to permit the reconstruction of a historic carriage house for the purpose of creating a dwelling unit.
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance allowing reconstruction of historic carriage houses as dwelling units, establishing application process, criteria, and applicable standards.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the Sight Distance Triangle Text Amendment.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed ordinance amending sight distance triangle regulations in Title 21A of the Salt Lake City Code, deferring final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the Sugar House Drive-Through Text Amendment.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the proposed ordinance prohibiting new drive-through facilities in the Sugar House Business District, deferring final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Capital Improvement Program Projects resolution.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing accepting comment on the FY2024 Capital Improvement Program project funding allocations, deferring action to a future meeting.

Approves all consent items including setting public hearing dates for the Ivory University House Public Benefits Analysis and Form Based Urban Neighborhood Zoning Text Amendment, reappointment of Dirk Burton to the Airport Board, and term correction for Beverly A. Langue to the Board of Appeals and Examiners.
